labs.title: Learn containerd
labs.description: Understand containerd's role in the container stack, then explore its architecture and practical runtime workflow.

labs.title: Learn Docker
labs.description: Learn Docker fundamentals, from images and containers to the workflows that lead into Kubernetes.

labs.title: Linux Containers from Scratch: Namespaces, Cgroups v2 & Rootless
labs.description: Build containers using pure Linux kernel primitives: PID, Mount, Net, User namespaces via unshare, cgroups v2 resource limits, and rootless sandboxing.

labs.title: Software Supply Chain Security: Distroless, SBOMs & Cosign Signing
labs.description: Secure the software supply chain: BuildKit secret mounts, distroless minimal base images, generating SBOMs with Syft, and image signing with Cosign.

labs.title: Learn Kubernetes
labs.description: Explore Kubernetes architecture and the concepts you need to deploy and operate containerized applications.

labs.title: Learn Helm
labs.description: Package, configure, and release Kubernetes applications with Helm charts and practical deployment patterns.

labs.title: Kustomize Master Lab: Bases, Overlays & GitOps Patching
labs.description: Master template-free configuration management with Kustomize: base manifests, environment overlays (dev, prod), patches, and ConfigMap hash rollouts.

labs.title: kubectl Essentials & Production Operations
labs.description: Master high-pressure incident response, advanced JSONPath queries, ephemeral container debugging, and cluster recovery.

labs.title: CKA Master Lab: Cluster Administration, Upgrades & Troubleshooting
labs.description: Master practical CKA skills: kubeadm upgrades, etcd disaster recovery, TLS bootstrapping, Gateway API, and secure RBAC onboarding.

labs.title: CKAD Master Lab: Advanced Workloads, Traffic & Observability
labs.description: Practical CKAD hands-on lab covering multi-container design patterns (sidecar, init, adapter), advanced probes, traffic splitting, CronJobs, ConfigMaps, and resource quotas.

labs.title: CKS Master Lab: Cluster Hardening & Runtime Security
labs.description: Implement production-grade security: API audit logging, kubelet hardening, Pod Security Standards, AppArmor, gVisor, secret encryption at rest, and Falco runtime detection.

labs.title: Policy as Code Master Lab: Kyverno & OPA Gatekeeper
labs.description: Implement declarative Kubernetes admission governance: validate, mutate, and generate policies with Kyverno, and author Rego constraints with OPA Gatekeeper.

labs.title: Kubernetes Networking Deep Dive: Services, Ingress & DNS
labs.description: Demystify Kubernetes networking: Pod-to-Pod CNI routing, ClusterIP iptables/IPVS translation, NodePort, Ingress TLS termination, and CoreDNS resolution.

labs.title: Service Mesh Master Lab: Istio Traffic Management & mTLS Security
labs.description: Master microservice networking with Istio: control plane architecture (istiod), Envoy sidecar injection, strict mutual TLS (PeerAuthentication), advanced traffic routing with VirtualService and DestinationRule, fault injection, and circuit breaking.

labs.title: Kubernetes Storage Deep Dive: PV, PVC, CSI & StatefulSets
labs.description: Master persistent storage: Container Storage Interface (CSI), dynamic volume provisioning, StorageClasses, PVC binding lifecycles, and StatefulSets.

labs.title: Kubernetes Observability Deep Dive: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry & Logging
labs.description: Implement end-to-end cloud-native observability: Prometheus Operator, ServiceMonitors, PromQL mastery, OpenTelemetry traces, and structured Loki logging.

labs.title: GitOps Master Lab: Continuous Delivery with Argo CD & Helm
labs.description: Implement declarative, zero-drift GitOps: Argo CD architecture, Application and ApplicationSet CRDs, automated sync policies, self-healing, and progressive canary rollouts with Argo Rollouts.

labs.title: Cloud-Native CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, OIDC & Automated Delivery
labs.description: Build production-grade container CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions: OIDC keyless cloud authentication, BuildKit multi-arch builds, Trivy CVE security gating, and GitOps triggers.

labs.title: Kubernetes Autoscaling Master Lab: HPA, VPA, KEDA & Karpenter
labs.description: Implement end-to-end multi-dimensional autoscaling: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA v2) with custom metrics, Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA), event-driven autoscaling with KEDA, and sub-minute node provisioning with Karpenter.

labs.title: Kubernetes Production Incident Response & Troubleshooting Playbook
labs.description: Real-world war-room triage: diagnosing validating webhook deadlocks, CoreDNS query blackouts, etcd split-brain latency, node eviction cascades, and zombie container recovery.

labs.title: Kubernetes Operator Pattern & Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)
labs.description: Build cloud-native automation with the Operator pattern: Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), controller reconciliation loops, controller-runtime, and automating Day-2 database operations.

labs.title: Building Kubernetes Operators in Rust: kube-rs & Custom Resources
labs.description: Master building memory-safe, high-performance Kubernetes operators and CRDs using Rust and kube-rs: CustomResource derive macros, async reconciliation loops, finalizers, and event watchers.

labs.title: Local Kubernetes Clusters: Multi-Node Kind, K3s & Fast Dev Loops
labs.description: Run multi-node Kubernetes clusters locally: configuring Kind with multi-node control planes, port forward mappings, lightweight K3s, and rapid development loops with Skaffold.

labs.title: Kubernetes Disaster Recovery & Backup with Velero
labs.description: Implement enterprise disaster recovery and migration with Velero: backing up Kubernetes resources, capturing CSI persistent volume snapshots, scheduling automated backups, and restoring namespaces.
